Long Description: The Visa Prepaid Load Network enables consumers to purchase and load Visa Prepaid cards as well as to add incremental value (re-load) to reloadable Visa Prepaid cards, such as general purpose, payroll, and other cards at merchant locations.  This service utilizes VisaNet and Interlink networks for the Issuer transaction approval and settlement of funds associated with these load/re-load transactions.  The Load Settlement Charge is paid by both Issuers and Acquirers to Visa for each load and re-load transaction settled through VisaNet.

Fee category: Network Fees and VisaNet Processing Charges
Fee Group: Interchange
Fee Name: Interchange Reimbursement Fee (IRF) Compliance Fee
Invoice Description: VISA INTERCHANGE REIMBURSEMENT FEE COMPLIANCE PROCESS - REVIEW FEE
Long Description: Members who believe interchange was incorrectly paid or received may submit a request through the Interchange Reimbursement Fee Compliance Process for Visa to determine the validity of their claim. Visa will consider all available evidence and rule in favor or against the filing member. The Review Fee is assessed to the filing member if neither the filing member nor opposing member withdraws the case during the Withdrawal Period. If Visa rules in favor of the filing member, Visa will rebate the Review Fee to the filing member and charge the opposing member.

Visa will consider all available evidence and rule in favor or against the filing member. If Visa rules in favor of the filing member, Visa will rebate the Screening Fee to the filing member and charge the opposing member.

Long Description: The Consumer Bill Payment Service (CBPS) is an optional service for third party consumer bill pay providers. Long Description: Estimated authorizations are used to secure funds when the purchase has started but the final transaction amount is unknown. It is an optional service for a merchant. Fee category: Acceptance Solutions

Note: A transaction may require more than one incremental authorization.

Fee category: Consumer Products
Fee Group: Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) Program
Fee Name: Annual Program Fees
Invoice Description: DCC AT POS ANNUAL PROGRAM FEE
Long Description: Under the Global Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) compliance program participating acquirers must register themselves, and their DCC services providers, with Visa and must certify with Visa to offer DCC according to the Visa Rules. The program also requires participating POS acquirers to perform annual merchant registration of their DCC-enabled merchants. As part of the program, Visa monitors DCC compliance including DCC data analytics, POS audits, and compliance enforcement with impacted acquirers when DCC is not offered in accordance with the Visa rules. Acquirers certified to offer DCC to Visa cardholders will be charged the program fee at the time of successful certification completion, and in October each year for the subsequent period 1 October through 30 September.

Fee category: Issuing Solutions
Fee Group: Visa Credential Enrichment Service (VCES)
Fee Name: Visa Credential Enrichment Service (VCES)
Client Type: Acquirer; Acquirer Processor; Issuer; Issuer Processor; Other
Invoice Description: VISA CREDENTIAL ENRICHMENT SERVICE - TOKEN PROVISION EXPIRY ENHANCEMENT
Long Description: Visa Credential Enrichment Service (VCES) supports Token Requestors in provisioning Tokens for their stored & validated PAN credentials, in cases where the PAN expiration date of the credential is no longer up-to-date/available. The Service maintains a mapping of PANs to Expiry Dates used in VisaNet Card-Present, Approved Chip txns, and utilizes this mapping to assist in creation of Tokens for eligible requests. For eligible Token provision requests with outdated/absent PAN expiration dates, the VCES service updates the PAN expiry date associated with credential within the provision request. Charge is assessed for each VCES-updated request resulting in a successfully provisioned Token

Fee category: Issuing Solutions
Fee Group: Visa Token Service (VTS)
Fee Name: Issuer OBO Credential Update Service
Client Type: Acquirer; Acquirer Processor; Issuer; Issuer Processor
Invoice Description: ISSUER OBO CREDENTIAL UPDATE SERVICE
Long Description: Issuers are sometimes unable to update credentials due to various reasons, leading to declined transactions, cardholder friction, and potential non-compliance penalties. To mitigate this, the Issuer OBO Credential Update Service will update expired Primary Account Numbers (PANs) and associated expired card-on-file or eCommerce tokens on behalf of issuers. This service aims to increase card-not-present authorization rates where Visa can access valid(newer) card expiry dates, thereby enhancing the overall e-commerce user experience by reducing out-of-date credential declines.

Fee category: Issuing Solutions
Fee Group: Visa Token Service (VTS)
Fee Name: Token Lifecycle Management (TLCM) Subscription Fee
Invoice Description: TOKEN LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT (TLCM) TOOL SUBSCRIPTION FEE
Long Description: The Token Lifecycle Management (TLCM) tool is a web-based application provided by Visa, accessible via the Visa Online (VOL) platform. This tool allows issuers to manually update token states and credentials. It is an integral part of the Visa Tokenization Program and is available to all active and basic issuers participating in the program.  The tool serves as an alternative to the Lifecycle Management (LCM) APIs and ISO messages, which provide automatic updates to token states and credentials. While these automated options are available, there have been instances where issuers have not been able to update consistently or correctly using the Visa Token Service (VTS) LCM APIs.  The TLCM tool thus serves as an essential component in maintaining token lifecycle management events, contributing to improved authorization approval performance and enhancing the cardholder experience. However, it's important to note that there are costs associated with maintaining the TLCM application each year, which Visa intends to recover.

Long Description: The one-time enablement fee is designed to better support the expansion and growth of tokens throughout the global ecosystem as the token adoption rate continues to accelerate. This fee will differ based on the type of token connection enabled and aims to cover the cost of supporting the client VTS integration effort while ensuring certification occurs in an effective and timely manner.

This service aims to increase card-not-present authorization rates where Visa can access valid(newer) card expiry dates, thereby enhancing the overall e-commerce user experience by reducing out-of-date credential declines.

A trip is considered insured if the full travel fare has been purchased with a valid and active international Visa card.  Pre-existing conditions are not covered.  Coverage is in excess of any other valid and collectible insurance.

Long Description: A Member is subject to a non-compliance assessment (NCA) for failing to adhere to any of requirements as described in Visas What To Do If Compromised (WTDIC) guide. The NCAs are designed to deter entities from failing to comply with the required procedures and timelines for reporting and responding to a suspected or confirmed compromise event. See WTDIC guide for specific Non-Compliance Assessment criteria.

Fee category: Risk and Security Intelligence Solutions
Fee Group: Investigation Fees
Fee Name: Investigation Fees
Invoice Description: INVESTIGATION FEE  ONE-TIME
Long Description: Investigation fees, as described in Visas What To Do If Compromised (WTDIC) guide, act as an incentive for clients to cooperate with Visa throughout each phase of the investigation lifecycle and to complete the investigation in a timely manner. Full cooperation during an investigation helps to quickly contain and mitigate a Compromise Event and minimize the resulting fraud impacting Visa clients. Investigation fees are only applicable to Payment Card Industry Forensics Investigator (PFI)-led investigations. If a PCI forensic investigation is not completed within 4 (four) full calendar months from the date Visa provided notice of the requirement for a PFI, Visa may impose a flat one-time fee for investigations involving Level 3 and 4 merchant investigations. See WTDIC guide for specific Investigation Fee criteria.

Fee category: Member to Member Fees
Fee Group: Merchant Services
Fee Name: Global Merchant Dispute Monitoring Program
Invoice Description: VISA ACQUIRER MONITORING PROGRAM NON-COMPLIANCE ASSESSMENT
Long Description: This non-compliance assessment is for acquirers whose portfolio consists of disproportionate number of merchants with excessive risk exposure. An Acquirer who meets or exceeds the Acquirer-level dispute activity thresholds will be charged a non-compliance assessment staring with $25,000 for each month they are above the program threshold.  In the event that the acquirer meets or exceeds the thresholds more than 3 times in a rolling 12 months period they will be assessed $50,000 USD for each subsequent month. In the event that the acquire meet or exceeds the threshold more that 6 times in a rolling 12 months they will be assessed $100,000 US dollar.

Visa does not list the merchant name for which the issuer is receiving a credit.
